features: Add an expandable SIGNAL MATRIX panel directly above the existing US-stock FLOW RADAR; the panel is available for both crypto and US-stock snapshots.

Render sortable columns for symbol, S-state, current price, midline gap %, midline slope, latest Heikin-Ashi average-K color, latest CCI-SMA smoothing color, 72H success probability, and true-fail probability; US-stock additionally shows the PW exchange column while crypto omits it.

Preserve existing semantic colors for S-state, yellow/purple technical colors, positive/negative values and probability/failure cues; rows where average-K and CCI-SMA are both yellow receive a subtle scan highlight.
No engine, probability model, Worker/R2 endpoint, chart, memo, research, filter, or sector-flow calculation is changed; the matrix reads fields already present in the current snapshot JSON.
